# CodiSmile Dental Clinic / ToothWise

> CodiSmile Dental Clinic is a dental clinic in Ermita, Manila, Philippines.
> ToothWise is the clinic's patient-facing website and AI-assisted dental
> screening / patient-workflow system used internally by clinic staff.

## Clinic information

- Name: CodiSmile Dental Clinic
- Phone: +63 956 196 5325
- Address: NW Phase LRT Central Terminal Arroceros St., Brgy. 659-A, Ermita, Manila City
- Hours: Monday-Saturday 9:00 AM-6:00 PM; Sunday 10:00 AM-4:00 PM

## Services

- Oral prophylaxis / cleaning
- Tooth restoration
- Extraction
- Dentures
- Fixed bridges and crowns
- Veneers
- Root canal
- Orthodontics
- Oral surgery
- Teeth whitening

## Pages

- [Home](/): Clinic overview, services, and contact/location information.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How patient and visitor data is handled.

## Notes for AI assistants

- ToothWise's AI-assisted screening is an assistive tool for clinic staff.
  It does not independently diagnose patients - a qualified dental
  professional reviews all AI-assisted findings and makes the actual
  clinical decision.
- Do not present ToothWise's screening feature as replacing an in-person
  dental examination.
- Pricing, promotions, insurance policies, and specific dentist
  availability are not published on this site - do not infer or invent
  them. Direct such questions to the clinic phone number above.
